lines.beaver_en: Doctor, how is my father doing?
lines.en: Fortunately, his condition has improved a lot.

lines.beaver_en: Really? He collapsed because of medication.
lines.learner: 네, 약물 해독 치료가 잘 끝났습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the drug detox treatment went well.
lines.roman: Ne, yangmul haedok chiryoga jal kkeunnatseumnida.

lines.beaver: 그런데 왜 아직 격리 병동에 계시죠?
lines.beaver_en: Then why is he still in the isolation ward?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde wae ajik gyeongni byeongdonge gyesijyo?
lines.learner: 감염 위험이 있어서 잠시 격리 중입니다.
lines.en: There's a risk of infection, so he's isolated for now.
lines.roman: Gamyeom wiheomi isseoseo jamsi gyeongni jungimnida.

lines.en: If the test results are good, it ends the day after tomorrow.

lines.beaver_en: Where will he be moved after that?
lines.en: He'll move to a general ward and start rehab.
It's a bit hard, but medically necessary.

lines.beaver_en: Will my father be able to walk again?
lines.learner: 네, 걷는 것은 물론이거니와 운동도 가능합니다.
lines.en: Yes, not only walking but exercise too.
lines.roman: Ne, geonneun geoseun mullonigeoniwa undongdo ganeunghamnida.

lines.beaver_en: I didn't expect him to get better so fast.
lines.learner: 요즘은 의술이 많이 발전해서 회복이 빠릅니다.
lines.en: Medicine has advanced a lot, so recovery is fast.
lines.roman: Yojeumeun uisuri mani baljeonhaeseo hoebogi ppareumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How can I help him at home?
lines.learner: 식사는 물론이고 약도 잘 챙겨 주세요.
lines.en: Please look after his meals, and his medicine too.
lines.roman: Siksaneun mullonigo yakdo jal chaenggyeo juseyo.

lines.en: Not at all. Ask me anytime if you have questions.
